summary: F8 (Default password = first 5 RUT digits + admin reset-password) end-to-end. Backend 12/12 pytest PASS: helper default_password_from_rut covers all spec cases ('17.234.567-8'->'17234', '8.234.567-9'->'82345', '12-3'->None, ''->None, None->None, '12345'->'12345'); POST /api/users derives pwd from RUT and returns initial_password (login OK); explicit password overrides RUT (login with explicit OK, derived fails); HTTP 400 when no password and RUT<5 digits or no RUT; POST /users/{id}/reset-password with empty body, omitted body and manual new_password all behave per spec; 404 on unknown user; 403 when caller is a worker (non-admin); CSV bulk-import derives pwd from RUT when password column empty and routes short-RUT rows to errors (verified login of created users with derived/explicit pwd); seeded jsoto@rioloaspa.cl/17234 still logs in (regression). Frontend 4/4 UI checks PASS on /admin/users: 'Nuevo Trabajador' dialog has NO user-password-input, shows blue info 'primeros 5 dígitos del RUT', after create the success card shows initial-password-value matching first 5 RUT digits; Configurar modal shows amber 'Contraseña' section with reset-password-btn and reset-password-result rendering the new password + toast ('Contraseña restablecida: 23521'); 'Carga Masiva' Sheet help text explicitly mentions 'Si password está vacío, se usa automáticamente los primeros 5 dígitos del RUT'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::reset_user_password correctly scopes target user by admin company via scoped_filter (returns 404 if user not in same company) and uses require_admin (403 for workers) — verified by tests.
server.py::create_user resolution order is explicit password > default_password_from_rut(rut) > HTTP 400; initial_password is returned ONCE in the response so admin can share it. Good UX.
routes_v2.py::bulk_import_users now imports default_password_from_rut from server and correctly routes rows with empty password and <5-digit RUT to the `errors` list (not `created`).
MINOR: PasswordResetPayload accepts only `new_password`; admin cannot force-derive from RUT explicitly while passing other fields. Current behavior (empty/missing body = derive) matches spec.
MINOR: bulk_import_users does not validate email format — relies on downstream login. Out of scope for F8 but worth a Pydantic validator pass later.
MINOR: server.py at 1748 lines is approaching the >700-line split threshold from the code-review guide; user/auth/reset endpoints could be moved to a routers module.
